scripts.build:ts: esbuild src/broker.ts src/page.ts src/popup-pane.ts src/options-pane.ts src/hover-pane.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --format=iife --target=es2020 --platform=browser
scripts.copy:static: mkdir -p dist && cp popup-pane.html options-pane.html hover-pane.html src/shared-pane.css dist/
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc --noEmit && npm run build:ts && npm run copy:static
scripts.package: npm run build && zip -r streamonio-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json dist icons -x 'icons/generate-icons.html'
scripts.dead-code:
ts-prune && echo '
--- Private unused functions (via lint) ---' && biome lint --only=correctness/noUnusedVariables src/
